title: brics bloc agrees joint declaration sources say 2026 09 12
text:
NEW DELHI, Sept 12 (Reuters) - The BRICS group of countries has agreed ​on a joint declaration, ‌which is unlikely to name any country but will condemn unilateral ​war by any country, four ​sources told Reuters on Saturday.
The ⁠bloc, which includes Brazil, ​Russia, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, ​Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran and the United Arab Emirates, is holding its annual ​summit in New Delhi ​this weekend.
Representatives of the member nations have ‌been ⁠engaged on bridging the divide between Iran and the United Arab Emirates, who are on ​opposite ​sides of ⁠the Gulf conflict, to produce a consensus ​declaration.
The leaders of the ​countries ⁠are expected to approve the declaration on Saturday, the sources ⁠said.
